additional_concerns: Footnote 3 is supplied in da12aecad4e68.u30.3569. Both permission claims' statements that its text is missing are stale. Its markers attach to XML and PDF, not the web form.

The XML permission is supported subject to the e-Cert requirement and the separately prescribed schema. The extracted XML claim omits the e-Cert qualification. Schema contents are unavailable; the anonymous dependency IDs cannot be reliably mapped to that authority.

Both compliance candidates expressly exclude XML-schema conformity from their XML facts. Their results can therefore establish only the selected channel, format and e-Cert control, not full XML submission compliance. The separate technical-test obligation also remains outside these formulas.

The source requires a Hongkong Post e-Cert but does not specify its operational use. Requiring it to be supplied or used for a particular submission may be a valid implementation interpretation, but is not established by this packet. What JFIU instructions establish that operational requirement?

The prescribed PDF form and operational e-Cert instructions are missing external materials needed to resolve the corresponding compliance classifications. No supplied dependency ID identifies either material.

The date-only resubmission candidate includes filings before 9:00am on 2 February 2026. This conflicts with an operational-launch interpretation of 'following its implementation'. The calendar-date channel provision and the explicit launch time must remain distinct interpretations rather than silently being equated.

The timestamp candidates select the operational-launch interpretation. The packet does not expressly supply a timezone or definitively resolve the exact boundary meaning of 'following its implementation'. What authority establishes the governing timezone and boundary interpretation?
The history candidate answers whether a triggering event ever existed; it does not determine whether a resubmission duty remains outstanding after a later compliant resubmission.

Non-filing events return FALSE in node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb but OUT_OF_SCOPE in the other event candidates. Preserve this domain distinction when comparing their results; direct blackout contact does not itself establish an STR submission.
